name: siheom-ts
description: siheom monorepo — data-first frontend test interpreter

scripts.ci: bun run check-format && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run check-exports && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' build && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' build
scripts.check-exports: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' check-exports && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' check-exports
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/react' typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/react-example' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@siheom/core' test && bun run --filter '@siheom/react-example' test
scripts.local-check: bun run format && bun run lint:fix && bun run build && bun run check-exports && bun run typecheck && bun run --filter '@siheom/react-example' test

author: Taehee Kim <rabolution@gmail.com> (https://x.com/stelo_kim)
